_hinweis: Vocabulary step on /teachers/lesson and /lesson: for each A1 word field in kursinhalte.json (bloecke[].wortschatz, keys must match exactly) a task for the learners and its words. A word that is a lemma of the A1 list (src/content/lexicon/a1.json) gets its article (il, lo, la, l'), plural and example sentence from there; a noun the list does not have may be written with its article ("la carta", "il codice fiscale"); phrases without an entry (Ciao!, letters) are shown as written here. Word fields without an entry only show the general task.

regional.note: Buongiorno is used until lunch in the north, often until late afternoon in the south, where Buonasera starts later.

Greetings (buongiorno, buonasera, ciao).aufgabe: Walk around the room. Say hello to three people, ask how they are and say goodbye: once with tu, once with Lei.

Countries and nationalities.aufgabe: Ask your partner: «Di dove sei?» – «Sono di …». Show the country on a map or on your phone.

Languages.aufgabe: Ask each other: «Che lingue parli?» Everyone says two languages. Write all the languages of the class on the board.

The alphabet and spelling your name.aufgabe: Spell your first name and your surname. Your partner writes it down. Use the Italian names for the letters: A come Ancona, B come Bologna …

Numbers.aufgabe: Count round the class to 20, then in tens to 100. Then say your phone number in pairs.

Address.aufgabe: Ask each other: «Dove abiti?» Write down your partner's address: street, number, postcode, town.

Email.aufgabe: Dictate an email address to your partner. Your partner writes it down and reads it back.

Forms: nome, cognome, indirizzo, data di.aufgabe: In pairs, fill in a form for each other: ask, listen and write in capital letters.

Family.aufgabe: Draw your family tree and explain it to your partner: «Questa è mia sorella. Si chiama …»

Married, single ….aufgabe: Ask politely: «È sposato?» or «Sei sposata?» Answer for yourself. Pay attention to the ending: sposato or sposata.

Describing people.aufgabe: Describe a person in the class. The others guess who it is: «È alta. Ha i capelli lunghi e neri.»

Rooms.aufgabe: Draw your flat or house. Show your partner around: «Questa è la cucina. Qui c'è il bagno.»

Furniture.aufgabe: Say what is in your living room. Your partner draws it: «C'è un divano. Ci sono due sedie.»

Colours.aufgabe: Find something in the room for every colour and say it: «La mia borsa è nera.» Pay attention: rosso, rossa, rossi, rosse.

grande / piccolo / luminoso.aufgabe: Describe your room with three adjectives. Your partner draws it. The adjective matches the noun: una stanza grande, un letto grande.

Food.aufgabe: Write your shopping list for the weekend. Read it to your partner, who says what is missing: «Manca il pane.»

Drinks.aufgabe: Ask three people: «Che cosa bevi la mattina?» Write the answers and tell the class.

Containers (una bottiglia di, un pacco d.aufgabe: Play shop: one person sells, one person buys. Use containers and quantities: «Vorrei una bottiglia d'acqua e un etto di prosciutto.»

Prices in euros.aufgabe: Write prices on cards. Your partner asks: «Quanto costa?» and you read the price: 3,50 € = tre euro e cinquanta.

Daily routine.aufgabe: Tell your partner about your morning: «Mi alzo alle sette. Poi mi lavo …»

Times of the day.aufgabe: Say what you do at each time of the day. Your partner asks: «Che cosa fai di sera?»

Days of the week.aufgabe: Ask each other: «Che cosa fai il lunedì?» Make a plan for the week and compare.

Hobbies.aufgabe: Ask three people: «Che cosa fai nel tempo libero?» Note the answers and report: «Marco gioca a calcio.»

Sport.aufgabe: Mime a sport. The others guess it: «Giochi a calcio?» – «No, nuoto!»

Music.aufgabe: Ask your partner about music: what do they like? Which singer, which song? Say why.

Weekend.aufgabe: Plan a weekend together: sabato mattina, sabato sera, domenica. Say who does what and when.

Places in town.aufgabe: Draw a small map of your town. Your partner asks: «Dov'è la farmacia?» – «È vicino alla stazione.»

Directions.aufgabe: Use the map. Explain the way from the station to the Comune: «Va sempre dritto, poi gira a sinistra.»

Transport.aufgabe: Ask three people: «Come vai al lavoro?» Count the answers: in autobus, in macchina, a piedi.

Tickets (biglietto, abbonamento, convali.aufgabe: Role play at the ticket office: buy a ticket to Bologna, ask for the platform and the time. Do not forget to stamp the ticket: «Devo convalidare il biglietto?»
woerter: Un biglietto per Bologna, per favore.
A che ora parte il treno?

The body.aufgabe: One person says a body part, everyone touches it. Then in pairs: «Mi fa male la testa.»

Illness.aufgabe: Mime an illness. The others guess: «Hai mal di testa?» – «No, ho la febbre!»

At the doctor's (il medico di base, la t.aufgabe: Role play at the doctor's: the receptionist asks for the tessera sanitaria, you say what is wrong. This is language practice, not medical advice.
woerter: Ho la febbre da due giorni.

Asking for an appointment.aufgabe: Role play: phone the surgery and ask for an appointment. The other person has a diary and offers two times.

Everyday actions.aufgabe: Mime something. The others guess with stare + gerund: «Stai cucinando?» – «Sì, sto cucinando!»

Plans for the weekend.aufgabe: Ask your partner: «Che cosa fai sabato?» Use the present for plans: «Sabato vado al mercato. Poi pranzo da mia sorella.»

oggi, adesso, domani.aufgabe: Make a timeline on the board: adesso, oggi, domani, ieri. Everyone adds one thing they do or did at each point.

Jobs.aufgabe: Mime a job. The others guess: «Sei un'insegnante?» – «No, sono cuoca!»

Workplaces.aufgabe: Say where people work: «Un insegnante lavora in una scuola.» Your partner adds a second job for the same place.

Hours and shifts (turni).aufgabe: Ask each other: «A che ora inizi? A che ora finisci?» Compare your working days and shifts (turni).

Clothes.aufgabe: Describe what a person in the class is wearing. The others guess who it is: «Ha una camicia blu e un paio di jeans.»

Sizes.aufgabe: Role play in a clothes shop: ask for a different size, colour or model. «Ha una taglia più grande?»

Paying.aufgabe: Role play at the till: the customer pays, the shop assistant asks about the receipt and the bag. Pay in cash or by card.

Months.aufgabe: Line up by birthday, gennaio to dicembre. Everyone says the date: «Sono nato il tre maggio.»

Festivals (Natale, Pasqua, Ferragosto).aufgabe: Tell your partner about a festival in your country and one in Italy: when is it, what do people eat, do you have a day off?

Invitations.aufgabe: Write a short invitation to a party. Your partner answers: accept or politely refuse and give a reason.

Congratulations.aufgabe: Go round the class: one person names an occasion (compleanno, matrimonio, nuovo lavoro), the next one congratulates.

Comune.aufgabe: Role play at the Comune: ask where the right counter is and what papers you need. The other person works there.

Poste.aufgabe: Role play at the post office: send a letter or a parcel, pay a bill. The other person is at the counter.

Forms.aufgabe: Swap forms with your partner and check them: is every box filled in? Is the date right, day first (03/11/2026)?

Anagrafe and residenza: the words.aufgabe: Read the words together. Then role play at the Anagrafe: you want to register your residence. This is language practice: what you need is on your Comune's website.
